items.statement: Emerton's construction applied to J_B(Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an}) gives a rigid space E(U^℘) with a map κ to T̂ and a coherent sheaf M(U^℘) with M(U^℘)^∨ = J_B(Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an})^∨; a point is a pair (δ,ω) with ω: T(U^℘) ↠ E, and lies on E(U^℘) iff Hom_{T(K)}(δ, J_B(Ŝ^{Q_p-an}[m_ω])) ≠ 0. It is classical when the same holds with Ŝ^lalg, and such a point has δ = δ_smδ_alg; it is generic when δ_smδ_B^{-1}|·|_K∘θ is a generic character.
items.note: Eigenvarieties for definite unitary groups are not planned anywhere in the atlas; O0 builds weight spaces and locally analytic representations for overconvergent forms, and PadicFamilies L2 the eigenvariety machine in the Hilbert/elliptic setting. The construction here is Emerton's, from the Jacquet module of a completed Banach space.

items.name: Proposition 4.14: basic geometry of E(U^℘)
items.statement: (1) E(U^℘) is equidimensional of dimension nd_K; (2) M(U^℘) is Cohen–Macaulay over E(U^℘); (3) E(U^℘) is reduced.
items.note: Deduced from Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)|_H ≅ C(H,E)^{⊕s} for a compact open H (Breuil–Ding Lem. 6.1) and the Breuil–Hellmann–Schraen machinery; reducedness follows Chenevier's argument.

items.name: Hypothesis 4.15: vanishing of the adjoint Selmer group
items.statement: The composition Ext^1_{g,S_p∖{℘}}(ρ,ρ) → Ext^1(D,D) → Ext^1(D,D)/Ext^1_g(D,D) is injective, where Ext^1_U(ρ,ρ) is the space of deformations ρ̃ with ρ̃^c ≅ ρ̃^∨ ⊗_E ε^{1-n} and Ext^1_{g,S_p∖{℘}}(ρ,ρ) is the subspace that is de Rham at every place of S_p other than ℘. In particular Ext^1_U(D,D) ∩ Ext^1_g(D,D) = 0.
items.note: Known in many cases: Allen Thm. A, Breuil–Hellmann–Schraen Cor. 4.12, Newton–Thorne Thm. A. It is the only global input besides classicality.

items.name: The Galois family on the eigenvariety and its properties
items.statement: On a small enough affinoid X ⊂ E(U^℘) around z_w there is a pseudo-character T_X: Gal_{F,S} → O(X) interpolating the ρ_z (Chenevier), which for ρ absolutely irreducible comes from a representation ρ_X: Gal_{F,S} → GL_n(O(X)) (Bergdall) such that (i) ρ_X^c ≅ ρ_X^∨ ⊗_E ε^{1-n}, (ii) ρ_{X,ṽ} is de Rham of weights ξ_v - θ^{F^+_v} for v ∈ S_p∖{℘}, and (iii) D_rig(ρ_{X,℘̃}) over R_{K,X} is a successive extension of the R_{K,X}(δ_{X,i}|·|_K^{2i-(n+1)}ε^{1-i}).
items.note: (ii) uses Berger–Colmez; (iii) is the global triangulation theorem of Kedlaya–Pottharst–Xiao/Liu in Bergdall's paraboline form, applicable because D is non-critical and φ-generic. Source issue: (i) is printed ρ_X^c ≅ ρ_X ⊗_E ε^{1-n}, without the dual, twice.

items.name: Proposition 4.17: smoothness of E(U^℘) at the companion points and Hypothesis 4.10
items.statement: Assume Hypothesis 4.15 and ρ absolutely irreducible. Then E(U^℘) is smooth at z_w for every w ∈ S_n, and Ext^1_U(D,D) — the image of Ext^1_{g,S_p∖{℘}}(ρ,ρ) in Ext^1(D,D) — satisfies Hypothesis 4.10 (1) and (2).
items.note: The tangent space T_{z_w} injects into Ext^1_U(ρ,ρ) with image in Ext^1_{g,S_p∖{℘}}(ρ,ρ) and then into Ext^1_{U,w}(D,D), so dim T_{z_w} ≤ nd_K = dim E(U^℘), which forces equality and smoothness.

items.name: Theorem 4.18: local–global compatibility for the definite unitary group
items.statement: Assume Hypothesis 4.15 and ρ absolutely irreducible, with Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^lalg[m_ρ] ≅ π_alg(φ,h)^{⊕r} and D = D_rig(ρ_{℘̃}) ∈ ΦΓ_nc(φ,h). Let π̃ be the closed subrepresentation of Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an}_{ρ̄}[a_T] generated by the images of the ι_w. Then there is a GL_n(K) × A_{D,U}-equivariant isomorphism π̃ ≅ (π_1(φ,h)^univ_U)^{⊕r}, and consequently π_min(D)^{⊕r} ↪ Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an}[m_ρ].
items.note: This is Theorem 1.1 (2) in the non-patched setting: the same argument as in §4.1, with M(U^℘) locally free of rank r, Proposition 4.14 (2) replacing local freeness of rank one, and Corollary 4.12 replacing Theorem 3.21.

items.name: Corollaries 4.20–4.21: maximality and the determination of the Hodge parameters
items.statement: π_min(D)^{⊕r} is the maximal subrepresentation of Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an}[m_ρ] generated by extensions of π_alg(φ,h) by π_1(φ,h); and for D' ∈ ΦΓ_nc(φ,h), π_min(D') ↪ Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)[m_ρ] if and only if D'_σ ≅ D_σ for all σ ∈ Σ_K. In particular, for K = Q_p the GL_n(Q_p)-representation Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)^{Q_p-an}[m_ρ] determines ρ_{℘̃}.
items.note: Uses that non-criticality of D is itself readable from Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)[m_ρ] by Breuil, Thm. 9.3.

items.name: The classicality input (4.14): multiplicity r of the locally algebraic vectors
items.statement: There is r ∈ Z_{≥1} with π_alg(φ,h)^{⊕r} ≅ Ŝ_{ξ,τ}(U^℘,E)[m_ρ]^lalg, by the local–global compatibility for l = p of Barnet-Lamb–Gee–Geraghty–Taylor together with Breuil–Ding (6.3).
items.note: R31.2 relates classical finite-level cohomology with algebraic coefficients to the locally algebraic vectors of completed cohomology; this is the same statement for a definite unitary group.

items.name: Global triangulation over an eigenvariety
items.statement: The theory of triangulations of families of (φ,Γ)-modules over affinoids: the relative Robba ring R_{K,X}, the fact that a family of Galois representations over a reduced affinoid with a Zariski-dense set of trianguline points is trianguline after shrinking, in the paraboline form of Bergdall and the form of Kedlaya–Pottharst–Xiao and Liu.
items.note: PG.7 owns the affinoid/relative Robba category of Kedlaya–Pottharst–Xiao and its source-qualified triangulation/specialisation inputs; the paper uses precisely those, applied at a smooth point of an eigenvariety.
